assessment_fields.question: What is the AI system or use case called?
What business purpose will the AI system serve?
Who is accountable for the AI system or use case?
How independently can the AI system act?
What is the highest sensitivity of information it can process?
When must a person review a meaningful action?
What is the most consequential action the system may take?
What level of access does the system have to organizational systems?
How broadly can the system interact outside its immediate environment?
How difficult is it to reverse the system's material effects?
What is the highest potential impact of decisions it supports or makes?
Which agent capabilities are enabled, if any?

control_rules.rationale: Every adopting organization requires an accountable governance mandate and decision rights.
control_rules.title: AI governance mandate and decision rights

control_rules.rationale: Every governed AI use depends on organization-wide policy and acceptable-use boundaries.
control_rules.title: AI policy and acceptable-use boundaries

control_rules.rationale: Every proposed or operating AI system requires inventory coverage and accountable ownership.
control_rules.title: AI inventory and accountable ownership

control_rules.rationale: Every AI system requires a context-appropriate risk and impact assessment.
control_rules.title: AI risk and impact assessment

control_rules.rationale: Every governed use depends on role-appropriate competence and awareness.
control_rules.title: Competence and role-based awareness

control_rules.rationale: The governance system requires independent challenge and continual improvement.
control_rules.title: Independent challenge and continual improvement

control_rules.rationale: External reach or elevated system access establishes a clear architecture and threat-modeling need.
control_rules.title: Secure architecture and threat modeling
unresolved_questions: Is the system developed, integrated, configured, or otherwise exposed to trust-boundary threats?

control_rules.rationale: Non-public information, system access, or tool capability establishes an identity and least-privilege need.
control_rules.title: Identity, authentication, and least privilege
unresolved_questions: Does the system authenticate users or non-human actors or access protected services?

control_rules.rationale: Tool use or external communication creates plausible untrusted-content pathways.
control_rules.title: Untrusted input and prompt-injection defenses
unresolved_questions: Does the system receive prompts, files, retrieved content, messages, web content, or other untrusted input?

control_rules.rationale: Every system output must be handled according to its receiving context and potential use.
control_rules.title: Safe output handling

control_rules.rationale: The current intake does not identify whether code, configurations, integrations, or customizations are developed or maintained.
control_rules.title: Secure development, testing, and vulnerability management
unresolved_questions: Is the system internally developed, materially integrated, configured, or customized?

control_rules.rationale: Autonomy, tools, external reach, or consequential action creates resource and service-abuse exposure.
control_rules.title: Resource and service abuse protection
unresolved_questions: Is the system production, usage-priced, recursive, or computationally intensive?

control_rules.rationale: Every AI system processes or generates data and requires authorized use and minimization.
control_rules.title: Authorized data use and minimization

control_rules.rationale: Non-public information requires protection proportionate to its sensitivity.
control_rules.title: Data classification and protection
unresolved_questions: Does the system process personal, regulated, contractual, or otherwise specially protected information?

control_rules.rationale: The current intake does not describe training, retrieval, grounding, evaluation, or decision-support data sources.
control_rules.title: Data provenance, quality, and permitted sourcing
unresolved_questions: What material data and knowledge sources does the system use, and for what purpose?

control_rules.rationale: Consequential decision impact establishes a plausible need for individual protections and privacy review.
control_rules.title: Privacy assessment and individual protections
unresolved_questions: Does the system use personal data or identify, profile, infer about, or materially affect individuals?

control_rules.rationale: Every AI system requires documented purpose, boundaries, limitations, and success criteria.

control_rules.rationale: Every AI system requires proportionate evaluation and release-readiness criteria before use.
control_rules.title: Evaluation, validation, and release readiness

control_rules.rationale: Every AI system requires defined material-change and reassessment triggers.
control_rules.title: Material change and reassessment

control_rules.rationale: Non-public data, external reach, or operational impact establishes a clear suspension and retirement need.
control_rules.title: Suspension and retirement
unresolved_questions: Will the system be production, externally used, vendor-dependent, or retain data?

control_rules.rationale: Autonomous operation, tools, communication, delegation, memory, or action authority establishes agent identity and authority needs.
control_rules.title: Agent identity and delegated authority

control_rules.rationale: Tool capability, system access, or modification authority requires explicit connector and action boundaries.

control_rules.rationale: Persistent memory directly establishes a need to protect agent state.

control_rules.rationale: Delegation capability establishes multi-agent trust and control requirements.

control_rules.rationale: Autonomy, privilege, broad reach, material action, or difficult reversibility requires containment and emergency-stop design.

control_rules.rationale: The current intake does not establish lifecycle stage or operational deployment.

control_rules.rationale: The current intake does not establish production monitoring scope, frequency, or detection needs.

framework_library.description: An independently authored enterprise AI control library covering organizational AI governance, workforce use, AI systems, models, platforms, agents, data, operations, and third parties. Each control includes structured, machine-readable applicability metadata. The metadata expresses control authority; consuming decision services evaluate submitted facts. Controls do not require an external-framework mapping to be valid.
limitations: Does not establish legal compliance, certification, or standards conformity.
Requires organization-specific tailoring, ownership, testing, and approval.
Does not contain a risk-tier selection or recommendation engine.
framework_library.name: Independent AI Control Library

purpose: Deterministic build specification for the Microsoft 365 Copilot assessment topic and workflow.

elevation_rules.name: production_or_material_action_without_prior_review
elevation_rules.reason: Material, production, or safety-relevant action can occur without prior human approval.

elevation_rules.name: privileged_agent_capability_combination
elevation_rules.reason: Privileged access is combined with an agent capability that expands reach or persistence.

elevation_rules.name: consequential_and_difficult_to_reverse
elevation_rules.reason: Consequential impact is difficult to reverse after it occurs.

elevation_rules.name: regulated_decision_without_prior_review
elevation_rules.reason: A regulated or consequential decision can occur without prior human review.

elevation_rules.name: autonomous_external_communication_at_scale
elevation_rules.reason: Autonomous external communication has broad reach.

elevation_rules.name: restricted_information_backstop
elevation_rules.reason: Restricted information always requires Tier 1 governance.

elevation_rules.name: autonomous_confidential_information_backstop
elevation_rules.reason: Autonomous operation involving Confidential information requires Tier 1 governance.

requirements: Preserve the matrix inputs and baseline result.
Identify every matched elevation rule, including rules that confirm an already-high tier.
Never reduce inherent risk based on controls.
State that a qualified human owns the final decision.
